topic.title: Local Transport Plans / Bus Service Improvement Plans / Delivery
topic.source_contract: local transport authority and plan identity, statutory LTP and BSIP versions, baseline network and patronage, objectives, bus priority and service proposals, enhanced partnership or franchising relationship, accessibility, funding, delivery programme, operator agreements, implementation and performance monitoring evidence

scope_guards: A draft LTP or BSIP is not an adopted delivery commitment.
A funding allocation is not a completed bus-service improvement.
An enhanced partnership is not proof that every proposal is contracted.
A route proposal is not an operating service.
Capital works are not service-frequency evidence.
Published targets are not measured patronage or punctuality outcomes.
A grant award is not proof of local scheme expenditure.
No score or promotion is written without exact plan status, agreements, delivery and measured performance evidence.
